purpose: Companies required to comply with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 must use Form AOC-3A to forward their statement containing salient features of financial statements.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Identify if your company must comply with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
Prepare the statement containing salient features of financial statements
Forward the statement in Form AOC-3A
checklist: Verify compliance with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015
Prepare the statement containing salient features of financial statements referred to in the first proviso to sub-section (1) of section 136
Ensure the form used is Form AOC-3A
watch: Ensure you use Form AOC-3A specifically if your company complies with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015.
